category_edits.rationale: Scale every NextItNet block's residual branch by 0.5 to reduce amplification of noisy context across all four category models. Preserve causal convolutions, embeddings, readout, scoring, loss and optimizer. The predictor writer imports the updated model class, so inference uses the identical formula without checkpoint shape changes.
